description: Judge an NFL fantasy football trade (dynasty or redraft): who wins, how confident the verdict is, the value of every player and pick on each side, the reasons, and what would even it out. Use for "is this trade fair?", "who wins this trade?", "should I accept?". Returns a link that opens the trade in the FantasyTrade Pro calculator.

league.description: League settings. Omit for the default: 12-team dynasty Superflex, full PPR, 1 QB / 2 RB / 3 WR / 1 TE / 1 Flex (+1 Superflex)

format.description: dynasty (keeper, multi-year value) or redraft (rest of this season only)

ppr.description: Points per reception: 1 full PPR, 0.5 half, 0 standard

superflex.description: True if teams can start a second quarterback (Superflex or 2QB). Default: true for dynasty, false for redraft

te_premium.description: Extra points per tight end reception

you_get.description: What the user would receive. Each entry is a player name ("Ja'Marr Chase") or a rookie draft pick: "2027 1st" (add early, mid or late if known, e.g. "early 2027 1st") or an exact slot "2027 1.03"

you_give.description: What the user would give up. Each entry is a player name ("Ja'Marr Chase") or a rookie draft pick: "2027 1st" (add early, mid or late if known, e.g. "early 2027 1st") or an exact slot "2027 1.03"

name: evaluate_trade
title: Evaluate a fantasy football trade
